status.en: 116 armed incidents reported in the past seven days, 19% fewer than the week before, most of them in Abuja, Lagos and Kaduna.
status.nb: 116 væpnede hendelser meldt de siste sju dagene, 19 prosent færre enn uken før, flest i Abuja, Lagos og Kaduna.

summary.en: Bandits are threatening to block roads and levy fees in Zamfara ahead of the 2027 elections, while armed gangs continue attacks across central Nigeria, killing civilians in villages, a mining site in Plateau, and a mosque in Niger state. Military personnel were accused of opening fire on civilians in Gombe, and gunmen in military uniforms killed a 60-year-old security guard in Plateau. ISWAP suffered a major loss with a Shura Council member and top commanders killed as troops repelled an attack in Borno. A funeral-bound boat capsized in southern Nigeria, killing at least 24 people. The conflict recorded 1,486 battle-related deaths in 2024, according to UCDP.
summary.nb: Banditter truer med å blokkere veier og pålegge avgifter i Zamfara før valget i 2027, mens væpnede gjenger fortsetter angrep over hele sentrale Nigeria, og dreper sivile i landsbyer, på en gruveplass i Plateau og i en moské i Niger-stat. Militærpersonell ble anklaget for å ha åpnet ild mot sivile i Gombe, og bevæpnede i militæruniformer drepte en 60‑år gammel sikkerhetsvakt i Plateau. ISWAP led et stort tap da et medlem av Shura-rådet og toppkommandanter ble drept da tropper avverget et angrep i Borno. En båt på vei til begravelse kantret i sørlige Nigeria, og minst 24 personer døde. Konflikten registrerte 1 486 dødsfall i kamp i 2024, ifølge UCDP.

background.title: Boko Haram insurgency
background.extract: The Boko Haram insurgency began in July 2009, when the militant Islamist and jihadist rebel group Boko Haram started an armed rebellion against the government of Nigeria. Boko Haram targets both Muslims and Christians. Attacks are often directed at individuals perceived as supporting the Nigerian government or Islamic State after the split between them, including civil servants, local defense groups, Muslim leaders who oppose the group and other rebels like al-Qaeda and Islamic State. Most attacks are not based on the religion of the victims.
